transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Well... I guess I'm here because of some things at church. People said I was... doing odd things. 

Like at the potluck. I'd just be standing by the table, holding the serving spoon up in the air and... just not moving. Or I'd be folding the same stack of napkins. Just over and over, while folks were waiting on me. I don't really know why.
During those moments when you freeze like that, are you aware of what is going on around you?
I don't really know. I guess... I just kind of drift off. It's hard to say what I hear or see then.
About how long do these freezing episodes usually last?
I'm not real sure. Nobody's ever timed me, I don't think. Maybe a few minutes... or longer. I couldn't say.
How has your mood been overall lately?
I don't rightly know. Just... same as always, I suppose. I haven't really paid it much mind. It's just fine.
Have you been hearing any voices or sounds that other people around you can't hear?
No... I haven't heard anything like that. Just the usual noises, I guess. Nothing out of the ordinary.
When you come back to yourself after one of those freezing spells, how do you feel physically and mentally?
I don't... I mean, just regular, I guess. Nothin' really different. I just go back to whatever I was doin'.
Have you had any thoughts or beliefs recently that other people found strange or couldn't understand?
No, sir. I don't think so. Folks don't say much about what I think. It's just... regular thoughts, I suppose. Nothin' strange.
Do you have any physical health problems or medical conditions that you are being treated for?
No, I don't... I ain't got no medical problems. Just fine, I guess. Nothin' I need a doctor for.
Has anyone ever told you that your arms, legs, or face twitch or jerk during these times?
No, sir. Nobody's... nobody's ever said nothin' like that to me. I don't think I do any of that.
Did anything particularly stressful, upsetting, or difficult happen in your life around the time these episodes began?

Well... I suppose... my friend passed on. My closest friend from the choir. That was... oh, about 11 months ago now. I guess things started changing around then. But I don't much like to talk about it.
When people try to speak to you or get your attention while you're frozen like that, are you able to answer them?
I don't... I don't rightly know. Ain't many folks around to try and talk to me anyway. I just... I ain't sure what happens.
Has anyone ever tried to gently move your arm while you were frozen like that?
No... I don't believe so. Like I was sayin', there ain't really anyone around to do somethin' like that. So... no, I don't think they have.
